title: GLC_FCS30D: Global 30 m Land Cover Dynamics, 1985–2022
description: Cloud-native mirror of GLC_FCS30D v2, a global 30 m land cover time series with 35 classes. It has one map every 5 years from 1985 to 1995 and one map each year from 2000 to 2022. The producers are Liangyun Liu, Xiao Zhang and Zhehua Li (Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences). This copy is a Portolan catalog of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs, one for each 5° tile and year, with embedded class colors. Source: Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.15063683. License: CC BY 4.0.
